messages:
Sam: FYI - two customer escalations about p95/p99 latency increases on chat API after the midnight runtime push. Both customers on dedicated -3 A100 pool. Logs show attention kernel fallback spikes.

Priya: saw it at 01:18 UTC. P99 jumped from ~90ms -> ~450ms for seq<=32. P95 up ~3x. Heatmap points to attention kernel fallback (flashattn->sdpa) increase. :eyes:

Ben: any recent kernel/compileflag changes in the deploy? IIRC we enabled flashopt compile flag in the canary and adjusted the sdpa heuristics yesterday.

deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-17T00:52Z completed to canary, rollout to prod started 2026-03-17T01:05Z.

Priya: pasting kernel selection / fallback snippet from runtime logs: 
```
kernel_select: model=redwood-chat-v2 seq=16 hw=A100 host=rt-045 kernel=flashattn compile_flags=O3 flashopt=1 heuristic=sdpa_prefer
fallback_count=0 -> after 01:05 fallback_count=27 fallback_reason=nvrtc_compile_timeout
```

Marta: NVRTC compile timeouts are suspicious. Could be transient compile jitter or memory fragmentation causing nvrtc to block. Both affected customers are on dedicated pools so not noisy neighbors.

Sam: CS-Bot forwarded the customer's repro: they run sustained concurrent short chats (concurrency=40, seq<=32). Repro snippet attached: 
```
# toy repro from customer
for i in range(40):
  spawn client.send(prompt="hi", max_tokens=16, model="redwood-chat-v2")
```

Ben: I repro locally on a single A100 VM with the same concurrency. Intermittent nvrtc timeouts appear and runtime falls back to SDPA (slower path) which explains the P99 spike.

Jordan: Mitigation options (ranked):
- quick: toggle flashopt compile flag off (fast rollback)
- safer: force kernel selection to prefer SDPA for short sequences on affected model/route
- infra: increase nvrtc compile timeout/retries and improve compile cache

Marta: Suggest short-term hotpatch: prefer SDPA for seq<=64 for the affected model to stop falling back mid-request. This avoids immediate rollback of flashopt and buys time to collect nvrtc traces.

Sam: Need an on-call owner to cut the hotpatch and coordinate canary. Also need messaging to CS that we're rolling a mitigation.

Ben: I'll cut the hotpatch. Patch diff: 
```
# runtime heuristic patch (hotpath)
if seq_len <= 64:
  kernel_hint = "sdpa_prefer"
else:
  kernel_hint = default_heuristic()
```
Pushing to canary now.

deploy-bot: starting canary rollout for hotpatch/5150003210-heuristic-sdpa-pref -> 5% at 01:40Z.

Priya: Canary metrics: hosts with hotpatch show P99 dropping ~60% for short seq traffic, P95 down ~30%. Early signal looks good. :thumbsup:

Sam: Updated CS: told customers we deployed a mitigation and expect improvement within 20-30m while we root cause nvrtc compile jitter.

Ben: If canary doesn't fully stabilize we'll rollback flashopt flag globally. I'm also collecting nvrtc build logs, device memory stats, and GPU driver metrics for correlation.

Jordan: Action items:
- Ben: monitor canary + upload nvrtc traces to S3 (actioned)
- Priya: correlate customer traces with route configs and return path IDs (in progress)
- Marta: open infra ticket for nvrtc jitter + driver checks (INC-2026-3210)
- Sam: update customers and CS threads

Sam: Closing loop once prod shows sustained improvement for 30m. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
